flags.why: The Northern tag incorrectly restricts a word widely used nationwide, including in [Southern reporting](https://thanhnien.vn/danh-sach-22-diem-co-nguy-co-un-tac-giao-thong-o-tphcm-1852601300924196.htm).
Ùn tắc is ordinary vocabulary for traffic congestion and is appropriate in everyday conversation.
Tiều is predominantly a Southern Vietnamese name for Teochew people and their language.
Người bộ hành belongs to formal or literary usage and would sound unusually bookish in casual conversation.
The noun denotes a small coastal inlet or bay, rather than a shelter or shed ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-x%C3%A9p)).
The example treats xép as a shelter on land, whereas its noun meaning is a small inlet ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-x%C3%A9p)).
flags.fix: Thuyền đi vào xép để tránh gió. = The boat entered the small inlet to shelter from the wind.

flags.why: The entry omits the common household or domestic-use meaning found in expressions such as điện dân dụng and thiết bị dân dụng.
flags.fix: adj | domestic; for household use — ex: Cửa hàng bán thiết bị điện dân dụng. = The shop sells household electrical equipment.
